Auth.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A sentence of several words is secure and easy to remember.

signup.title: Create an account
signup.intro: ERIKA receives, checks and archives your e-invoices. Sign-in is protected by a second factor.
signup.done: We sent an email to {email}. Click the link in it to confirm your address.

verify.title: Confirm email address
verify.done: Thank you! Your email address is confirmed. You can sign in now.
verify.missingToken: The link is incomplete. Please open the link from the email again.

totp.title: Verification code
totp.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
totp.useRecovery: No access to the app? Use a recovery code
totp.useApp: Use a code from the app

setup.title: Set up two-factor sign-in
setup.intro: A second factor is required to protect your invoices. Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 2FAS).
setup.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
setup.manual: Or enter this key by hand:
setup.codesIntro: Keep these codes safe, e.g. printed. Each code works once if you can't use your app. They are shown only now.
setup.continue: I have saved the codes – continue

Workspace.title: Company details
Workspace.intro: These details will appear on your invoices.
Workspace.name: Company name
Workspace.readOnly: Only the owner can change these details.

Errors.INVALID_CODE: The code is wrong or has expired.

Errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.

Errors.UPLOAD_FILE_MISSING: The file didn't arrive. Please upload it again.
Errors.UPLOAD_SIZE_MISMATCH: The file didn't arrive completely. Please upload it again.
Errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

Inbox.title: Inbox
Inbox.intro: Your invoices arrive here – uploaded, or sent by email to your intake address. ERIKA scans every file for viruses, archives the original so it can't be changed, and checks e-invoices against the official rules.
Inbox.addressHint: Give this address to your suppliers. Attachments (XML, PDF, ZIP) are imported automatically.
Inbox.empty: No documents yet. Upload an invoice or have it sent to your intake address.
Inbox.processingNote: {count, plural, one {# document is} other {# documents are}} being checked …

Upload.heading: Upload invoices
Upload.hint: XRechnung (XML), ZUGFeRD/Factur-X (PDF), other PDF invoices or a ZIP with several files – at most 20 MB per file.
Upload.tooLarge: {name}: the file is larger than 20 MB.
Upload.failed: {name}: the upload didn't work. Please try again.
Upload.itemDuplicate: {name}: possible duplicate – this file is already in the archive.

IntakeReason.VIRUS_FOUND: Malware was found in the file. It was not imported.
IntakeReason.UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE: This file type is not supported (only XML, PDF and ZIP).
IntakeReason.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than 20 MB.
IntakeReason.FILE_MISSING: The file didn't arrive. Please upload it again.
IntakeReason.ZIP_TOO_DEEP: The ZIP contains ZIP files nested too deeply (at most one level).
IntakeReason.ZIP_TOO_MANY_FILES: The ZIP contains more than 50 files.
IntakeReason.ZIP_BOMB: The ZIP is suspiciously highly compressed and was rejected for safety.
IntakeReason.ZIP_ENCRYPTED: The ZIP is encrypted. Please upload the files unencrypted.
IntakeReason.ZIP_DAMAGED: The ZIP is damaged and can't be opened.
IntakeReason.NO_ATTACHMENTS: The email had no usable attachments.

notEInvoiceReason.PLAIN_PDF: This PDF contains no structured invoice data. Since 2025, invoices between businesses in Germany must generally be e-invoices (XRechnung or ZUGFeRD); such invoices are still allowed for a transition period. ERIKA has archived the file unchanged anyway.
notEInvoiceReason.INSUFFICIENT_PROFILE: The file only has a ZUGFeRD profile (MINIMUM or BASIC-WL) that doesn't count as an e-invoice. Ask the supplier for an invoice in the EN 16931 or XRechnung profile.
notEInvoiceReason.ZUGFERD_1: The file uses the outdated ZUGFeRD 1.0 format, which no longer counts as an e-invoice.
notEInvoiceReason.UNKNOWN_XML: The XML file is not an invoice in UBL or CII format.
notEInvoiceReason.UNKNOWN_PROFILE: The invoice names no known specification (BT-24).
notEInvoiceReason.UNREADABLE: The file could not be read.
